.jsx.description: UI library for component-driven SPAs and interactive frontends.
conversion_guidance: Prefer functional components and hooks over class components.
Co-locate component, styles, tests, and stories when possible.
Use controlled inputs for forms and memoization only when profiling indicates bottlenecks.
Use React Router for SPA navigation and clearly separate route-level and feature-level components.
Prefer strict TypeScript adoption for medium/large codebases where feasible.
project_structure: src/services or src/api for server calls
testing: React Testing Library for behavior tests
